DSI-Bench: A Benchmark for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence
	

Paper | Project Page | Code

	
		
		Abstract
	

Reasoning about dynamic spatial relationships is essential, as both observers and objects often move simultaneously. Although vision-language models (VLMs) and visual expertise models excel in 2D tasks and static scenarios, their ability to fully understand dynamic 3D scenarios remains limited.
